object: crown ether@UiO-66 MOF membranes
problem: How to achieve fast, selective monovalent ion transport through membranes via complete ion dehydration.
mechanism_or_method: In situ growth of UiO-66 with confined dibenzo crown ethers combining size sieving and interaction screening.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; simulations only presumably explain dehydration; long-term stability not described.

object: China EV lithium-ion battery recycling system
problem: Can closed-loop battery recycling relieve critical material scarcity under China's EV targets, and at what collection rate?
mechanism_or_method: Integrated scenario framework combining material flow, environmental, geospatial optimization and cost analysis through 2060.
limitation: Results depend on scenario assumptions about deployment, technology and prices through 2060.
decision_relevance: Sets minimum battery collection rate and recycling siting for supply stability.

object: liquid metal nanoparticle polymer composites for 4D printing
problem: How to 3D print liquid metal-polymer composites that show NIR-triggered shape memory for soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: RAFT agents grafted on liquid metal nanoparticles formed in situ in stereolithography resin enabling photothermal shape recovery.
limitation: Only lab demonstrations; mechanical properties are reduced and long-term cycling is not reported.

object: ultrasonic contact-electro-catalysis for precious metal reduction
problem: Can water-solid contact electrification drive reduction and extraction of precious metal ions from solution?
mechanism_or_method: Ultrasound-driven contact electrification at water-solid interfaces produces electrons reducing metal ions, supported by EPR and ab initio simulation.
limitation: Mostly synthetic solutions; real e-waste leachate performance and scaling are only briefly shown.

object: hyperbranched epoxy supramolecular thermosets
problem: How to make epoxy thermosets that are both tough and closed-loop recyclable at room temperature.
mechanism_or_method: Vanillin-based hyperbranched epoxy with hydrogen bonds, dynamic imine bonds and cavities dissipating energy and enabling depolymerization.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; durability under service conditions and cost are not addressed.

object: bilayer polymer moisture-electric generator with radiative cooling
problem: How to sustain moisture-electric power output despite daytime evaporation and environmental fluctuations.
mechanism_or_method: Hydrophobic radiative-cooling top layer over LiCl hygroscopic ionic hydrogel creating stable internal water and ion flow.
limitation: Low power density (about 51 microwatt per cm2) and only six days of outdoor operation.

object: solar-wind driven sorption atmospheric water harvesting device
problem: How to raise water productivity of sorption-based atmospheric water harvesting with continuous operation.
mechanism_or_method: Hygroscopic interconnected porous gel plus concentrated sunlight and natural wind coupling for desorption, condensation and sorption kinetics.
limitation: Outdoor yields much lower than indoor record; depends on solar concentration and local weather.
decision_relevance: Informs design of off-grid passive water harvesting devices.

object: lithium-ion battery cell carbon footprints
problem: What is the distribution of carbon footprints of NMC811 and LFP batteries given material sourcing variation?
mechanism_or_method: Cost-based emission curves for lithium, nickel and cobalt from mining cost data combined with regionalised production announcements.
limitation: Cost-to-emission proxy relies on assumptions and announced rather than realised production.
decision_relevance: Prioritises material sourcing over plant location in battery decarbonisation policy.

object: 3D-printed biodegradable Zn-Li porous bone scaffolds
problem: How to reconcile fast degradation and toxicity in porous Zn scaffolds while promoting immunomodulatory bone ingrowth.
mechanism_or_method: Multiscale design: Zn-0.8Li eutectoid lamellar microstructure, nano-rough surface and isotropic minimal-surface G lattice.
limitation: Animal model only; long-term degradation and clinical translation are untested.

object: nanoconfined water in vertically aligned carbon nanotube solar evaporators
problem: Why does solar evaporation rate rise as nanochannel diameter shrinks, exceeding the theoretical limit?
mechanism_or_method: Janus CNT@AAO evaporators with experiments, theory and molecular simulation showing fewer hydrogen bonds and lower energy barrier.
limitation: Mechanism described as a possible reason only; scalability of CNT arrays unaddressed.

object: heterocyclic aramid fibers with SWNT additions
problem: How to raise strength and toughness of aramid fibers simultaneously despite their intrinsic trade-off.
mechanism_or_method: In situ polymerization with 0.05 wt% short aminated SWNTs improving crystallinity, orientation and interfacial stress transfer.
limitation: Lab-scale spinning; impact protection performance not tested at component level.

object: wood-inspired 3D-printed metamaterial flow catalysts
problem: How to decouple mechanical strength, mass transport and catalytic efficiency in high-throughput water purification catalysts.
mechanism_or_method: Overlapping microlattices with bimodal pores made by metal 3D printing and electrochemical Co decoration, plus simulation.
limitation: Lab-scale reactor tests; long-term catalytic stability and cost of metal printing not addressed.

object: freezing salty water droplets
problem: What governs freezing dynamics and morphology of small saline droplets compared with pure water?
mechanism_or_method: Observation of brine films and ice sprouting controlled by condensation at the brine free interface, validated by molecular dynamics.
limitation: Single-droplet lab conditions; applicability to sea spray and desalination systems not tested.
decision_relevance: Guides anti-icing and droplet freeze desalination design.

object: electrothermal active origami from 4D-printed continuous carbon fiber composites
problem: How to realize precisely controlled, load-bearing, reconfigurable active origami.
mechanism_or_method: 4D printing continuous carbon fibers in shape memory composite with Joule heating and multiphysics modeling for actuation control.
limitation: Lab demonstrators; energy use, speed and fatigue life of repeated actuation not reported.

object: grayscale DLP 4D-printed shape-morphing structures
problem: How to enable cold-programmed shape morphing in printed shape memory polymers with freer reconfigurability.
mechanism_or_method: Grayscale digital light processing printing heterogeneous hinge modules that are cold-programmed by stretching at room temperature.
limitation: Material-specific requirements and lab demonstrations only; load capacity not quantified in abstract.

object: FCC high-entropy alloy with interstitial-driven local chemical order
problem: How to obtain FCC alloys with ultrahigh strength and ductility at ambient and cryogenic temperatures.
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic development of interstitial-driven local chemical order domains from planar-slip bands, promoting cross-slip, transformation and twinning.
limitation: Small lab samples; fatigue, fracture and scale-up behavior at cryogenic temperature not addressed.

object: lithium-ion battery lifetime prediction models
problem: Is fitting capacity and resistance fade sufficient to parameterise degradation models, or are degradation modes needed?
mechanism_or_method: Compare three models with up to five coupled degradation mechanisms against capacity, resistance and degradation modes at three temperatures.
limitation: Validated on one cell type at three temperatures; generalisation to other chemistries untested.
decision_relevance: Requires degradation mode analysis when parameterising battery lifetime models.

object: nanoporous graphene membrane for organic solvent nanofiltration
problem: How to get ultrafast, switchable-cutoff organic solvent permeation through layered graphene membranes.
mechanism_or_method: Thermal pore activation of graphene oxide followed by microwave-assisted reduction giving smooth sp2 domains and dense nanopores.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term fouling and scale-up beyond cross-flow tests not shown.

object: transparent ultrasound transducer for ultrasound and photoacoustic imaging
problem: How to overcome acoustic impedance mismatch so transparent transducers match opaque ones in sensitivity and bandwidth.
mechanism_or_method: Transparent silicon dioxide-epoxy composite matching and backing layers with tuned acoustic impedances.
limitation: Small-scale devices; imaging demonstrated in few animals and humans only.

object: high-entropy alloy electrocatalyst surfaces for oxygen reduction
problem: How to quantitatively predict local reactivity of high-entropy alloy surface sites for oxygen reduction.
mechanism_or_method: Descriptor combining active-center d-band filling and neighborhood electronegativity, validated with external DFT calculations and activity maps.
limitation: Computational predictions without experimental validation of proposed Pd-rich and Ir-rich alloys.

object: woven liquid crystal elastomer fiber soft actuators
problem: How to overcome limited deformation and complex manufacturing in fiber soft actuators for multifunctional soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: Rope-weaving of electro-driven LCE fibers into twisting, four-strand, orthogonal and diagonal weaving actuators.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of locomotion and pumping; durability and power efficiency not quantified.

object: high-entropy alloy nanocrystals of platinum-group metals
problem: How to synthesize HEA nanocrystals in a controllable and predictable manner rather than by trial and error.
mechanism_or_method: Predict structure from precursor reduction kinetics and mixing entropy under dropwise addition of mixed precursor solution.
limitation: Demonstrated for one quinary platinum-group system; generality to other compositions unproven.

object: CALF-20 metal-organic framework for CO2 capture
problem: How do water interactions and framework flexibility govern CO2 and water adsorption in CALF-20?
mechanism_or_method: Combine adsorption isotherm experiments with atomistic simulations, DFT and machine-learned potential molecular dynamics.
limitation: Single material; simulation accuracy of water adsorption depends on force field and potential quality.

object: wearable bioadhesive ultrasound shear wave elastography patch
problem: How to continuously monitor liver stiffness without a handheld probe during rapidly changing acute liver failure.
mechanism_or_method: 128-channel compact bioadhesive transducer array generating acoustic radiation force impulses to induce shear waves.
limitation: Rat model over 48 hours only; human validation and long-term skin adhesion not shown.

object: ionic diode films for hybrid electromagnetic and moisture energy harvesting
problem: How to couple electromagnetic absorption with moisture-enabled generation for wireless energy harvesting and signaling.
mechanism_or_method: Polyelectrolyte/conjugated polymer bilayer ionic diode films whose ion gradients rectify moist-energy and electromagnetic-energy interaction.
limitation: Low-power lab demonstrations; stability under real ambient conditions is not shown.

object: pangolin-inspired untethered magnetic soft robot with localized heating
problem: How to give soft magnetic miniature robots efficient on-demand localized heating without losing compliance.
mechanism_or_method: Bi-layered pangolin-like scale design integrating metallic heating elements with soft magnetic body, driven by external magnetic fields.
limitation: Tested on tissue phantoms and ex vivo tissue only; no in vivo validation.

object: polyMOF/PIM-1 mixed matrix membranes for CO2 separation
problem: How to build MOF nanoparticles that disperse well in polymers and give membranes beyond CO2 permselectivity upper bounds.
mechanism_or_method: Carboxylated PIM-1 ligand coordinated with metals forming approximately 100 nm polyMOF nanoparticles, cast into mixed matrix and thin-film membranes.
limitation: Gas tests on lab membranes; long-term aging and mixed-gas industrial conditions unaddressed.

object: Co single-atom catalyst on hydroxylated ZnO for Fenton-like oxidation
problem: How to selectively generate different active species across different oxidant systems with one single-atom catalyst.
mechanism_or_method: Isolated asymmetric Co-O-Zn sites with surface hydroxyls modulating oxidant adsorption, supported by DFT.
limitation: Pilot-scale tests limited to benzoic acid wastewater; broader matrix and catalyst lifetime unclear.

object: additively manufactured work-hardened medium-entropy alloy
problem: Can high initial dislocation density increase rather than reduce ductility in work-hardened alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Segregation-dislocation self-organized structures act as dislocation sources and form Lomer-Cottrell locks and jogs for dislocation storage.
limitation: Shown for one additively manufactured alloy; fatigue and scale-up behavior not addressed.

object: hygroscopic gel self-powered energy harvesting and sensing interface
problem: How to extend transient moisture-induced voltage into continuous power with integrated sensing for flexible electronics.
mechanism_or_method: Hygroscopic polymeric gel confines and locks moisture on metal oxide substrate, giving sustained voltage and capacitive sensing.
limitation: Low voltage output (0.32 V); stability beyond four days and real-use durability not shown.

object: refractory high-entropy alloys TiZrHfNbTa and VNbMoTaW
problem: What intrinsic factors make one BCC refractory HEA ductile at low temperature and another brittle?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments, theory and modeling relating HCP-to-BCC element ratio to dislocation core structure, lattice distortion and slip planes.
limitation: Only two prototypical alloys compared; generalisation across the refractory HEA space is untested.
decision_relevance: Guides HCP/BCC element ratio choice for ductile refractory alloys.

object: short-range order in CoCrNi-based multi-principal element alloys
problem: How does processing and cooling rate affect short-range order formation in FCC multi-principal element alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Additive manufacturing across wide cooling rates, semi-quantitative electron microscopy and atomistic simulation of the solidification front.
limitation: Three CoCrNi-based FCC alloys only; the SRO measurement is semi-quantitative.

object: arrested phase separation hydrogels
problem: How to achieve hydrogels with both high strength and low hysteresis for load-bearing uses.
mechanism_or_method: Interpenetrating hydrophilic and hydrophobic networks arrested at microscale phase separation, linked by entanglements.
limitation: Only one polymer pair demonstrated; fatigue and long-term hydration behavior not reported.

object: phase change material aerogels for thermal shock protection
problem: How to get low-cost insulation that also resists transient high-temperature loads.
mechanism_or_method: Encapsulate phase change materials in a micron-porous framework so heat absorption delays heat propagation.
limitation: Thermal conductivity only on par with conventional insulation; stable only up to 300 C.

object: MoSx-Hbeta catalyst for polyolefin hydrocracking
problem: How to convert impure, mixed waste polyolefins into liquid alkanes without pretreatment or noble metals.
mechanism_or_method: Bifunctional noble metal-free MoSx on Hbeta zeolite for hydroconversion at 180-250 C and 20-30 bar H2.
limitation: Batch-scale reactor tests; hydrogen demand and continuous-process lifetime not demonstrated.

object: spent LiCoO2 as photothermal catalyst for polyester upcycling
problem: Can spent battery cathodes be reused to catalyse solar upcycling of waste polyesters into monomers?
mechanism_or_method: Li deficiency contracts Co-O6 units in spent LCO, boosting photothermal depolymerization yield, with life-cycle assessment.
limitation: Lab-scale reactions; economic and emissions figures rely on extrapolated assumptions.

object: PVC-based dielectric elastomer with cyanoethyl cellulose
problem: How to get dielectric elastomers with high permittivity and low viscoelasticity for actuation and sensing.
mechanism_or_method: Add cyanoethyl cellulose to plasticized PVC gel, raising permittivity and reducing mechanical loss.
limitation: Lab samples; long-term cycling life and environmental stability not described.

object: hydrated La3+ ion layers in aqueous superlubrication
problem: How does hydration layer structure, set by ion surface coverage, control friction under subnanometer confinement?
mechanism_or_method: Characterize hydration layers on surfaces lubricated by trivalent electrolytes, linking structure to two superlubric regimes and dissipation pathways.
limitation: Molecular-scale model system with trivalent La3+ only; macroscopic lubricant relevance unproven.
decision_relevance: Informs ion choice and coverage for water-based lubricants.

object: crack-array strain sensors for soft robots
problem: How to make predictable, durable compliant strain sensors for soft robot perception.
mechanism_or_method: Programmed crack array within micro-crumples with physical models, plus machine learning for trajectory and altitude prediction.
limitation: Demonstrated on one origami robot; performance in uncontrolled environments untested.

object: triboelectric self-powered abyssal ocean current meter
problem: How to measure deep-sea currents with a self-powered, pressure-resistant, wide-range sensor.
mechanism_or_method: Triboelectric nanogenerator with magnetic coupling structure and variable-spacing design harvesting current energy for sensing.
limitation: Single deep-sea deployment; long-duration reliability and biofouling effects not reported.
decision_relevance: Enables self-powered deep-sea current monitoring without batteries.

object: laser powder-bed fusion Al0.5CrCoFeNi high-entropy alloy
problem: How to raise strength without sacrificing fracture resistance in alloys.
mechanism_or_method: Printed nano-bridged honeycomb microstructure of fcc cells and B2 net, with dislocation channels shielding crack tips.
limitation: One alloy and processing route; fatigue and large-component behavior not covered.

object: atomically strained In2S3 photocatalyst for CO2 reduction
problem: Can atomic-scale strain in In2S3 enable visible-light CO2 photoreduction in ambient air?
mechanism_or_method: Oxygen coordination and sulfur vacancies introduce strain, modifying band structure and carrier separation, shown by in situ spectroscopy and theory.
limitation: Low CO production rate (5.16 micromol per g per h); stability and selectivity in air not detailed.

object: patterned liquid crystal elastomer snap-through elements
problem: How to overcome the slow actuation rate of LCEs to produce rapid, powerful snap-through leaping.
mechanism_or_method: Locally patterned director orientation and through-thickness modulus gradients create stimuli-induced mechanical instability, with validated computational model.
limitation: Lab-scale elements; repeatability over many cycles and untethered stimulation not addressed.

object: light-powered disulfide-crosslinked hydrogel underwater robots
problem: How to overcome diffusion-limited actuation speed of hydrogels for high-speed programmable underwater motion.
mechanism_or_method: Photo-activated disulfide exchange programs network anisotropy so thermally driven chain conformation change replaces mass diffusion; photothermal fillers add light actuation.
limitation: Small lab swimmers; payload, efficiency and untethered control are not shown.

object: 4D-printed ceramics via hydrogel-ceramic laminates
problem: How to realize shape-changing 4D printing of ceramics despite their weak deformability.
mechanism_or_method: Multimaterial DLP printing of hydrogel-ceramic laminates that bend on dehydration then sinter, with a curvature model for design.
limitation: Shrinkage and sintering defects limit accuracy; mechanical properties of final ceramics not detailed.

object: 4D-printed active composite plates
problem: How to efficiently design material distributions that achieve target 3D shape changes in active composites.
mechanism_or_method: Residual network forward shape prediction combined with gradient descent and evolutionary algorithms for inverse material-distribution design.
limitation: Validated on numerically generated target shapes; no printed experimental verification stated.

object: Ti-Zr-Nb medium-entropy alloys with ordered oxygen complexes
problem: Can ordered oxygen complexes raise strength and ductility in other alloys, and how are they tailored?
mechanism_or_method: Tune Nb and oxygen content to reduce phase stability, enhance chemical short-range order and favor ordered oxygen complex formation.
limitation: Limited to bcc Ti-Zr-Nb alloys; excessive oxygen causes grain boundary segregation.

object: wireless miniature magnetic soft robots for tissue sensing
problem: Can wireless soft robots sense physiological tissue properties in situ with minimal invasion?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic field control of robot-tissue interaction, recovering adhesion, pH and viscoelasticity from robot shape and fields tracked by imaging.
limitation: Ex vivo porcine and mouse tissue only; in vivo validity untested.

object: isotropic ceramic nanofiber aerogels via ice templating
problem: How to scale up isotropic nanofiber aerogels with thermal insulation and mechanical robustness under extreme conditions.
mechanism_or_method: Rotating cryogenic drum freezing, crushing and re-casting decouple ice nucleation and growth, inducing columnar-equiaxed crystal transition.
limitation: Battery module protection shown at lab scale; manufacturing cost and throughput not quantified.
decision_relevance: Supports thin aerogel layers to block battery thermal runaway propagation.

object: electrochemical lithium extraction from geothermal brine
problem: Can lithium be selectively extracted from geothermal brine and converted to battery-grade LiOH economically?
mechanism_or_method: Intercalation-based selective extraction, LiCl purification and bipolar membrane electrodialysis, with parametric techno-economic assessment.
limitation: Cost estimate assumes 0.5-year electrode lifespan; tested on lab scale with Salton Sea brine.

object: millimeter-scale soft robot for intracardiac interventions
problem: How to give catheter tools dexterity, stability and force inside the beating heart.
mechanism_or_method: Soft robotic platform that deploys and self-stabilizes at heart entrance and guides existing interventional tools.
limitation: Two exemplar right-atrium procedures; clinical-scale safety and durability not established.

object: DNA hydrogels for solar desalination and uranium extraction
problem: Can solar evaporation hydrogels simultaneously desalinate seawater and selectively extract uranium?
mechanism_or_method: Uranyl-specific DNA hydrogel whose solar interfacial evaporation drives ion transport to selective binding sites.
limitation: Modest uranium capacity (5.7 mg per g); DNA cost and stability in seawater are unaddressed.

object: self-folding magnetic soft-robotic chains
problem: How to exceed catheter and access-port size limits with reconfigurable continuum soft robot tools.
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic soft-robotic chains self-fold into large assemblies via combined elastic and magnetic energies when pushed from catheter sheath.
limitation: Benchtop demonstrations; in vivo performance and reliability of repeated assembly not shown.

object: polyurethane foam with catalytic CO2-releasing potassium salts
problem: How to make flammable polymers fire safe without conventional flame-retardant elements.
mechanism_or_method: Potassium formate or malate triggers polymer auto-pyrolysis rearrangement that releases CO2 before combustion to extinguish fire.
limitation: Small-scale flammability tests on polyurethane foam; effect on mechanical properties and aging not stated.

object: boiling crisis on heated surfaces
problem: Is there a unifying criterion that predicts the boiling crisis across surfaces, regimes and fluids?
mechanism_or_method: Percolation-based near-wall bubble interaction instability set by nucleation site density, bubble footprint radius and growth-time-frequency product.
limitation: Needs measurement of three boiling parameters; tested only on water and liquid nitrogen.
decision_relevance: Guides boiling surface design to maximize critical heat flux.

object: coaxially printed magnetic-mechanical-electrical core-sheath fibers
problem: How to build soft devices combining magnetic actuation, sensing and energy transfer without delamination or leakage.
mechanism_or_method: Coaxial printing of core-sheath fiber with magnetoactive and conductive phases into 2D/3D hybrid structures.
limitation: Lab demonstrators; biomedical use not validated in vivo and durability limited to demos.

object: spent lithium-ion cathode Al foil and active layer separation
problem: How to separate Al foil from cathode active material quickly without damaging the active material.
mechanism_or_method: Phytic acid forms an in situ passivating aluminum complex layer, enabling reaction-passivation driven separation.
limitation: Demonstrated on one cell chemistry at single-cell scale; economics and continuous processing not shown.

object: temperature-adaptive dual-modal photonic textiles
problem: How to achieve autonomous solar heating at low temperature and radiative cooling at high temperature in one textile.
mechanism_or_method: Fibers coated with thermochromic microcapsules in graphene and barium sulfate giving about 80% visible optical modulation.
limitation: Comfort gain limited to 8.5 C; wash durability and wear comfort are unreported.

object: 3D-printed dynamic covalent polymer network
problem: How to reprogram geometry and mechanical properties of 3D-printed polymers after printing.
mechanism_or_method: Photo-printable network with hindered urea bonds and hydroxyls enabling two independent exchange reactions for reshaping and property tuning.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; reprogramming conditions and long-term network stability are unreported.

object: naturalistic driving environment simulation for autonomous vehicle testing
problem: How can a simulator reproduce real-world driving statistics, including rare safety-critical events, with statistical realism?
mechanism_or_method: NeuralNDE deep learning of multi-agent interaction from trajectory data with a conflict critic model and safety mapping network.
limitation: Validated on urban driving trajectories only; rare long-tail event coverage depends on available data.
decision_relevance: Enables statistically realistic simulation for autonomous vehicle safety testing.
